id: title:Gilbert09:implement the proofpoint tap import source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Proofpoint TAP warehouse ingestion support, including authentication, resumable queries, and error handling.
review.reason: This chunk represents a complete implementation of a Proofpoint TAP warehouse source. It adds the source to supported tables, removes it from exclusion lists, and defines typed configuration fields for authentication. It also implements resumable and cursor-based ingestion, allowing checkpointing and incremental queries, and distinguishes authentication failures from transient HTTP
